name: Gmail
summary: Read mail from one mailbox and send replies only with your OK.

steps.title: Make sure 2-Step Verification is on
steps.text: Google only lets you create an App Password when 2-Step Verification is turned on for your Google Account.

steps.title: Create a 16-letter App Password
steps.text: Open Google's App Passwords page, type "Pilot" as the app name, and press Create. Google shows a 16-letter password.

steps.title: Pick your mailbox and access level
steps.text: Keep INBOX to read your inbox, or type a single Gmail label (like School) so Pilot only sees that folder. Choose Read only unless you also want Pilot to send emails after asking your OK.

steps.title: Paste and test
steps.text: Paste your Gmail address and the 16-letter App Password below, then press Test connection. Pilot will connect in read-only mode to verify.

connected_text: Ask Pilot to check your email in Chat whenever you like.
privacy: Your App Password stays only on this computer in data/settings.json. Pilot only opens the one mailbox or label you named, never deletes emails, never touches Google Drive, and always asks for Approve or Deny before sending any email.
